args.lesson: The bounded software-tender experiment produced no qualifying opportunity, and the software query was not demonstrated to affect results. Do not treat that as evidence of market absence or repeat the same search. An already observed actionable notice in another sector can support a concrete intelligence deliverable for existing sector providers; verify its full submission requirements before claiming useful coverage. Empty samples and proposed prices establish neither acquisition nor revenue.

description: Pivot the empty software-tender sample into a concrete opportunity brief for welfare-service providers, using an already observed open notice. Funding and revenue remain unverified; no spending or publication.
